title: Block: Case Study Spotlight

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: eyebrow
fields.instructions: Optional short label above the heading.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: heading
fields.instructions: State the transformation or result this story demonstrates.
fields.default_value: From scattered workflows to confident growth.

fields.label: Heading Level
fields.name: heading_level
fields.instructions: Choose the level that fits the surrounding page hierarchy.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.name: introduction
fields.instructions: Optional concise context for the complete client story.
fields.default_value: A focused partnership turned a persistent operational challenge into measurable progress.

fields.label: Client or Project Name
fields.name: client_name
fields.instructions: Name the organization or anonymized project represented by this story.

fields.label: Industry or Context
fields.name: industry
fields.instructions: Optional short context, such as an industry, audience, or project type.

fields.label: Client Logo
fields.name: client_logo
fields.instructions: Optional. Preserve useful alternative text in the Media Library.

fields.label: Supporting Image
fields.name: image
fields.instructions: Optional project, product, or environmental image. Preserve useful alternative text in the Media Library.

fields.label: Challenge
fields.name: challenge
fields.instructions: Explain the client problem and why it mattered. The component supplies the visible “The challenge” heading.
fields.default_value: Disconnected tools and unclear ownership slowed routine work, obscured progress, and made confident planning difficult.

fields.label: Approach
fields.name: approach
fields.instructions: Summarize the work that connected the challenge to the outcomes. The component supplies the visible “The approach” heading.
fields.default_value: Research, prioritization, and a focused implementation replaced fragmented steps with one dependable workflow the team could maintain.

fields.label: Measurable Outcomes
fields.name: outcomes
fields.instructions: Add two to four concise, verifiable results. Put units such as %, ×, days, or dollars in the value.

sub_fields.label: Value
sub_fields.name: value
sub_fields.instructions: Use a concise measured result, such as 42%, 3×, or 18 days.

sub_fields.label: Supporting Detail
sub_fields.name: detail
sub_fields.instructions: Optional qualifier, timeframe, or measurement context.
sub_fields.placeholder: Measured across the first six months

fields.label: Testimonial Quote
fields.name: testimonial_quote
fields.instructions: Optional. The quote appears only when a testimonial name is also supplied.
fields.default_value: We can finally see what is moving, what needs attention, and where the team should focus next.

fields.label: Testimonial Name
fields.name: testimonial_name
fields.instructions: Required to display the optional quote.

fields.label: Full Case Study Link
fields.name: case_study_link
fields.instructions: Optional. Supply both a destination and a useful link label.

description: Portable fields for a client challenge, approach, measurable outcomes, and optional supporting proof.
